reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Disclaimer writing, timeframe, and delivery methods
headings.reviewNote: Covers requirements for disclaimer writing, delivery within nine months or before acceptance, and delivery or filing with probate division.

headings.title: Right to disclaim despite transferor intent or restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Covers independent right to disclaim notwithstanding transferor intent to the contrary, spendthrift provisions, or similar restrictions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on disclaimer execution, nine-month delivery timeframe, probate division filing, and override of transferor restrictions (L. 1997 S.B. 265).

headings.title: Acceptance by conduct and preclusion of disclaimer
headings.reviewNote: Covers acceptance by conduct or benefits precluding later disclaimer, subject to exceptions in sections 469.090 and 469.100.

headings.title: Disclaimer or acceptance by authorized representative
headings.reviewNote: Covers authority of agent, guardian, conservator, or personal representative to disclaim or accept on behalf of a person.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on acceptance by conduct precluding later disclaimer and representative authority to accept or disclaim (L. 1997 S.B. 265).

headings.title: Definitions for bank, fiduciary, person, and principal
headings.reviewNote: Covers definitions of bank, fiduciary, person, and principal for uniform fiduciaries provisions.

headings.title: Good faith defined

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections defining Uniform Fiduciaries Law terms and good faith; notes 2004 transfer from former section 456.240.

headings.title: Fiduciary allocation priorities and governing instruments

headings.title: Impartial administration standard for fiduciary powers
headings.reviewNote: Covers duty of impartial administration when exercising section 469.405 adjustment powers or discretionary administration powers, and presumption of fairness.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections on fiduciary allocation priorities and impartial administration under Missouri Principal and Income Act (L. 2001 H.B. 241).

headings.title: Trustee authority to adjust between principal and income
headings.reviewNote: Covers trustee power to adjust between principal and income when managing under prudent investor rule to achieve impartial administration.

headings.title: Factors considered in exercising adjustment power
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory factors trustee must consider including trust terms, nature and duration, beneficiary circumstances, and economic effects.

headings.title: Prohibited adjustments affecting taxes, beneficiaries, and trustees
headings.reviewNote: Covers restrictions prohibiting adjustments affecting marital deductions, gift tax exclusions, charitable trusts, or benefiting trustee.

headings.title: Exercise of adjustment power by eligible cotrustee
headings.reviewNote: Covers authority of disinterested cotrustee to exercise adjustment power when other trustee is disqualified.

headings.title: Release of adjustment power by trustee
headings.reviewNote: Covers trustee authority to permanently or temporarily release adjustment power to preserve tax benefits or avoid burdens.

headings.title: Adjustment power not limited absent clear contrary terms
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that trust terms limiting adjustments do not affect this section unless clearly intended to deny the subsection 1 adjustment power.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all six subsections on trustee adjustment authority, statutory factors, eight prohibitions, disinterested cotrustee action, release, and trust-term construction (L. 2001 H.B. 241).

headings.title: Two-year bar on breach claims after trustee report
headings.reviewNote: Covers two-year judicial-proceeding bar on impartial-administration breach claims for qualified and other beneficiaries after adequate trustee report disclosure.

headings.title: Rules for adequate disclosure, notice, and fraud exception
headings.reviewNote: Covers adequate-disclosure standard, notice under section 469.402, date for identifying qualified beneficiaries, and preservation of fraud or misrepresentation actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked both subsections and corrected both drafted headings/notes: subsection 1 sets a two-year (not one-year) bar after trustee reports, and subsection 2 states four disclosure, notice, and fraud rules rather than Uniform Trust Code references.

headings.title: Calculation and adjustment of unitrust amount
headings.reviewNote: Covers 3% to 5% unitrust calculation, proportionate reductions/increases, prior-quarter adjustments, short-period proration, and valuation-error corrections.

headings.title: Definitions for unitrust determinations
headings.reviewNote: Covers definitions of rolling-quarter "average net fair market value" (lesser of quarters since inception or twelve) and "current accounting year".

headings.title: Exclusions from average net fair market value
headings.reviewNote: Covers exclusions from average net fair market value for beneficiary-occupied residential or tangible personal property and specifically given assets with their returns.

headings.title: Annual valuation of non-traded assets and claim bar
headings.reviewNote: Covers annual good-faith valuation of real or non-actively-traded property, conclusiveness, and two-year claim bar incorporating section 469.409(2) rules.

headings.title: Trust applicability, trustee election, and three-year claim bar
headings.reviewNote: Covers application to post-August 28, 2001 express trusts, trustee election with 60-day notice and 3%-5% (default 3%) rate subject to section 469.405(3)-(4), and three-year action bar.

headings.title: Unitrust amount as net income, payment order, and capital gains
headings.reviewNote: Covers treating unitrust amount as net income, four-tier payment source order absent contrary terms, and permissive allocation of short- and long-term capital gains.

headings.title: Calculation option for trusts subject to section on August 28, 2011
headings.reviewNote: Covers trustee written discretion for trusts already subject to this section on August 28, 2011, to calculate under pre- or post-amendment provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all seven subsections on unitrust calculation, definitions, exclusions, annual non-traded asset valuations, applicability and trustee election, payment ordering with capital gains, and the 2011 transition option; corrected shifted/inaccurate draft headings and notes.

headings.reviewNote: Covers four rules on pre-distribution fractional interest, exclusion of specific and pecuniary gifts, aggregate value without unpaid principal obligations, and valuation date.

headings.title: Fiduciary records for collected but undistributed net income
headings.reviewNote: Covers fiduciary duty to maintain records showing each beneficiary's interest in collected but undistributed net income.

headings.title: Permissive application to realized principal gains and losses
headings.reviewNote: Covers fiduciary discretion to apply section rules to realized net gain or loss from disposing of a principal asset.

headings.title: Successive income interest beginning date
headings.reviewNote: Covers beginning date for successive income interest on day after preceding income interest terminates.

headings.title: Date an income interest ends
headings.reviewNote: Covers ending of an income interest on the day before beneficiary death or terminating event, or last day of a period with no permissible income beneficiary.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all four subsections on income interest start, asset trust-subject dates, successive interests, and end date; replaced shifted draft heading/note on subsection 4.

headings.title: Determination of due dates and distribution declaration dates
headings.reviewNote: Covers determination of due dates for obligations, corporate distributions, leases, and periodic payments.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked all four subsections on timber receipt allocations by growth rate, depletion deduction, pre-trust harvesting, and August 28, 2001 timberland transition rules.
